name: car-rental
description: Owners let someone use their car for a day or a week, for money.

description.description: The car and its terms, or the car looked for.

price.description: The price per day or per week.

payment.description: How the rental may be paid: direct, rental, or both.

place.description: Where the car is picked up and returned.

dates.description: When the car is free, or wanted: from pickup to return.

deposit.description: Money held against damage, given back when the car returns as it left.

insurance.description: What insurance covers the renter while driving, and what the renter pays after damage.

onTime.description: Whether the car was handed over, or returned, at the agreed time.

asAgreed.description: Whether the car was as the post said at pickup, or as it left at return.

howDealsGo: The owner and the renter agree in messages on the car, the dates, the deposit and how the keys change hands, and pay outside Forest. After the rental each may review the other. A review of the person who wrote the post names it.
